notes: No state-by-state figures were found in the Integrated Annual Report 2025-26 or the BRSR 2025-26 (both the newest editions, for the year ended Mar 31, 2026), and no company state-wise report was found. The only location counts are in the BRSR 2025-26 (company-hosted; it covers standalone Reliance Industries Limited, not the consolidated group): 15 plants and 65 offices in India, 0 plants and 2 offices abroad. The same table says RIL served 35 Indian states and union territories and exported to 112 countries in FY2025-26. The Integrated Annual Report 2025-26 says Reliance Retail opened 1,564 stores during the year, "taking the total store count to 20,160 stores", with no split by state; it is not combined with the BRSR row because it comes from another document on a group basis. Sites come from the report's "Plant Locations in India" list (standalone RIL), unchanged from 2024-25. Nagothane Manufacturing Division is omitted because the list does not state its location separately; Vadodara Composites Division and the Compressed Biogas plants are omitted for the 12-site cap. Jio, Retail and other subsidiaries' facilities are not listed. The annual report URL is the one the report itself gives (www.ril.com/reports/).
